dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: Ya-hey, you'll miss out if you just walk about! Come on, try digging for some treasure instead!

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: How about it? Are you interested?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is this, anyway? Do you mean that we can dig up treasure somewhere amongst these piles of dirt?

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: These piles of earth are filled with anything from cabbages to ore. There's some truly good stuff in there, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can't we just keep digging till we get the good stuff, then?

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: No, of course not. Now, I'm not going to lie to you, or my name's not Old Chou! See, some piles of dirt also have explosives hidden within them. You can keep digging so long as you don't dig any of those up.

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: But once you do, it's game over — game over!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Explosives? That sounds like a dangerous game we're playing here.

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: Oh, no worries, these were all pilfer— I mean, borrowed on the sly many years ago from the underground mining camps. They're definitely duds, right down to the last one!

dialogues.speaker: Old Chou
dialogues.text: So, how about it? Want to have a go?
